nodes.statement: Exact internal symmetry Z3_m x Z3_E
A and B are local Lorentz-scalar SM singlets with charges (1,0) and (0,1)
All Standard-Model fields are neutral under the dual symmetry
The projected charge has a nontrivial three-element kernel
A and B have equal projected charge and unequal kernel charge
Kernel-sensitive cross kinetic, bilinear, mixed-cubic, phase-sensitive quartic, and off-diagonal Higgs-portal operators are forbidden
The forbidden-operator surface is perturbatively RG invariant
Kernel-changing S-matrix amplitudes vanish in exact TP-D
The complete H+A+B quartic boundedness problem reduces to exact three-by-three copositivity conditions
The complete 36-channel high-energy scalar/Goldstone quartic spectrum reduces to fixed multiplicities and a three-by-three singlet block
Two independent one-loop scalar-quartic RGE derivations agree coefficient by coefficient
Two independent scalar mass and cubic one-loop RGE derivations agree and preserve the separate Z3 cubic tensors
Charge-three scalar vacuum expectation values in U(1)_m x U(1)_E leave the exact residual group Z3_m x Z3_E
The frozen scalar-only TP-G0 parent is free of continuous gauge and mixed gravitational anomalies because no chiral fermion carries a new charge
The complete scalar-only one-loop beta system for all 17 CP-conserving TP-G quartics is independently tensor checked
B0 has an analytically certified global inert electroweak tree vacuum
B0 passes high-energy scalar/Goldstone quartic unitarity and finite-energy physical-scalar unitarity to 20 TeV
B0 loses the one-loop BFB condition through the Higgs direction near 3.57e8 GeV
The leading B0 quartic-bounce diagnostic gives S4 about 961 below the scalar-unitarity boundary but is cutoff dominated
Equal stabilizing portals in B1 keep quartics copositive but make the simple inert certificate fail when muH2 crosses zero near 2.31e8 GeV
Asymmetric portal B2 extends the simple certificate to about 1.46e15 GeV but is near-critical with minimum BFB margin about 3.3e-6
TP-G0 has a certified factorized global tree vacuum and passes the complete 78-channel high-energy scalar and Goldstone quartic unitarity test
TP-D high-scale running cannot be assigned to TP-G0 above the approximately 0.63 and 0.90 TeV parent thresholds
The factorized TP-G0 zero-portal surface is not one-loop RG invariant: lambda_APhi_m and lambda_BPhi_E have positive scalar and gauge source terms
Leading one-loop step-matched TP-G0 running loses its sufficient BFB certificate near 3.56e8 GeV, reaches scalar unitarity near 3.33e16 GeV, and reaches a 4pi coupling near 6.28e16 GeV
Gamma(B -> A + h)=0 when the channel is kinematically open and kernel symmetry is exact
In TP-Bsoft with only dimension-two A-B breaking, 2 G12 cos(2 theta) = (G22-G11) sin(2 theta) at tree level
The frozen TP-G0 benchmark contains an E-sector radial state with no open tree-level decay and is cosmologically incomplete until its lifetime and abundance are controlled
The leading coupled annihilation, semi-annihilation, and conversion calculation gives Omega h^2 about 1.82 for B0, so B0 is rejected as a standard thermal-relic benchmark

For the tested minimal TP-D EFT, diagonal SM-Higgs exchange maps to the standard elastic, momentum-independent, approximately isospin-conserving SI nucleon limit after component local-density rescaling
All four relic-compatible points from the 160-point leading scan are excluded by the LZ 2025 power-constrained 90% C.L. SI limit; their minimum excluding abundance-weighted ratio is 37.17

A reduced Higgs-pole point at mA=62.0 GeV and mB=62.2 GeV reproduces Omega h^2 about 0.12 in a finite-width-validated coupled thermal diagnostic and has a combined LZ rate proxy about 0.242 while passing tree BFB and scalar unitarity; its one-loop absolute-stability certificate ends near 3.36e8 GeV

For the Higgs-pole point, the complete new tree-level TP-D electroweak-vector channel block through 20 TeV has maximum J=0 singular value 1.805e-5 and satisfies the exact longitudinal/Goldstone equivalence identity; pure-SM vector scattering is unchanged because A and B are zero-vev electroweak singlets

The Higgs-pole point matched to the protected zero-kinetic-mixing TP-G parent passes all controlled finite-energy gauge blocks through 20 TeV, with maximum neutral J=0 eigenvalue 0.191; the verdict remains conditional because the unstable parent vector produces a physical on-shell u-channel scalar pole requiring a complex-mass or stable-state inclusive treatment for an unconditional S-matrix statement

The pole point gives Omega h^2=0.11887 with a temperature-dependent equation of state and finite-width off-pole thermal averaging; its nearly degenerate two-component LZ rate ratio is 0.2395 and its Higgs-invisible branching fraction is 1.69e-4

Cubic-induced number-changing rates are negligible for the pole point, while point-matched one-loop running loses absolute stability near 3.36e8 GeV but gives a leading-log bounce action about 886 before the scalar-unitarity cutoff and a cosmologically long-lived electroweak vacuum

At the matched pole point both parent vectors and both parent radials decay promptly to dark scalars, the conservative Planck energy-injection ratio is 0.00489, and no late parent relic, dark radiation, or relevant defect constraint remains

Broad TP-D novelty fails: semi-annihilation, multicomponent discrete dark matter, local U(1)-to-Z3 completion, product residual symmetries, and symmetry-protected transition zeros are established mechanisms; novelty of the exact projection/kernel presentation is not demonstrated

Exact TP-D supplies genuinely parameter-reducing falsifiable null amplitudes but no unique nonzero observable sum rule; the nonzero two-state Higgs alignment relation belongs only to the softly broken extension and is standard mixing algebra
The TP-Bsoft alignment relation is basis-covariant once the charge basis is operationally identified, but it is standard two-state algebra, is not loop-complete, and is not a unique TP-D prediction
Perform threshold matching, quantify two-loop uncertainty, and calculate the multi-field effective-potential bounce where required

Complete point-specific parent threshold/RG evolution and, if an unconditional full-S-matrix claim is required, replace the pole-excised unstable-vector diagnostic by a complex-mass or stable-state inclusive calculation

Upgrade the conditionally viable Higgs-pole candidate with precision thermal-QCD input, a detector-level two-component xenon likelihood, finite parent threshold/two-loop running, and a gauge-controlled numerical multi-field bounce
The rejected B0 parent retains its rho_E issue and is not repaired; the surviving pole parent instead opens prompt rho_E to BBB plus charge conjugate, so this is not a blocker for the promoted point
Gravity, flavour, fundamental constants, quantum gravity, and unification remain outside the validated theory and must not be claimed; optional precision upgrades do not authorize those extensions
